description.value: JoieFarm is an estate winery perched on the Naramata Bench with vineyards spread across the South Okanagan, one of BC's most celebrated cycling wine routes. The property features a tasting room and The Hot Dog Lounge, offering visiting cyclists a place to sample wines and grab a bite alongside the vines. The winery positions itself as a pursuer of 'West Coast wonder and beauty,' crafting small-lot, terroir-driven wines from its estate vineyards.
